decision: Choose eu-west-1: ADR 0007 requires customer lists to stay in EU regions, and the jobs carry the customer list. I recorded Mira's all-products rule against logging customer names as new ADR 0024 in mira-decisions.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024 (decision key log-pii): no product or repository, existing or future, writes a customer's name into any log. Quotes Mira's words, dated 2026-10-22.
